#### **2. Initiate Refund Process**
   - **Method:** Use the company’s **refund portal/system** (or manual request if automated).

     - Justification: *"Incorrect shipment address (planned to Pune DC but shipped elsewhere). Refund approved per eligibility check by worker-Y."*
     - Attach a note: *"See contract record C-1724 for registered site verification."* [m2]
   - **Save/Submit** the refund request.

#### **3. Update Customer Communication**
   - **Email/Case Note Template:**
     > *Subject:* Refund Confirmation for Ticket C-1724
     >
     > Dear [Customer Name],
     >
     > We’ve processed your refund request for the reshipping fee (₹310) related to ticket **C-1724**. The refund will reflect in your account within **3–5 business days** [or per your company’s refund timeline].
     >
     > - **Registered Site:** Pune DC (confirmed via contract) [m2].
     > - **Eligibility:** Approved as eligible per our refund policy [m4].
     >
     > If you don’t see the refund by [date], reply to this email with your order/invoice details.
     >
     > Regards,
     > [Your Name/Team]

   - **Add to Ticket:** Log the email/case note in the system under C-1724.

#### **4. Close the Ticket**
   - **Status:** Mark as **"Resolved – Refund Processed"**.
   - **Final Check:**
     - Attach the **refund confirmation ID/reference** to the ticket.
     - Add a closing note:
       > *"Refund of ₹310 initiated for reshipping fee. Customer notified via [email/case note]. Contract site verified as Pune DC [m2], eligibility confirmed [m4]."*

#### **5. Escalation (If Needed)**
   - **Delays:** If the refund fails (e.g., system error), notify planner/worker-Y to investigate.
   - **Customer Follow-Up:** If the customer disputes the refund, flag for audit with worker-X/Y.

---
**Deadline:** Complete within **24 hours** (or per team SLA).
**Priority:** High (customer expects resolution for incorrect shipment).
